panels.description: At the percentile picked above. From taking a message off the mailbox to its handler returning, awaits included. A handler that replies from a background task counts only until it hands the work off. Read from the traces, one span per message: exact rather than from histogram buckets. The points are exemplars, single messages; a click on one offers its trace in Explore. A click on a line offers the messages around that moment on the Messages dashboard.

targets.query: { span.sequencer = "$sequencer" && span.actor = "$actor_type" && (span.instance =~ "$instance" || span.instance = nil) } | quantile_over_time(duration, $percentile) by (name)
